youtube_title: Jesus... Why Do I Feel Guilty For Cancelling Plans? 😔 | Mark 6:31 #Shorts
youtube_description:
Jesus's Replies — an imagined reply from Jesus to a real, unspoken prayer.

She cancelled on her friend three weekends in a row to rest and then spent the whole Sunday feeling guilty about it.

She: Jesus... why do I feel guilty every time I cancel plans? 😔
She: Three weekends in a row now. I just wanted my own bed and quiet.
Jesus: You cancelled one evening. You didn't cancel the friendship.
She: But she asked again, and I said no again. Good friends show up, right?
Jesus: Resting isn't letting her down. I told My own friends to come away and rest.
Jesus: Rest isn't a debt you owe. It's how you come back a better friend.

“And He said to them, “Come with Me privately to a solitary place, and let us rest for a while.” For many people were coming and going, and they did not even have time to eat.”
Mark 6:31 (BSB)

Rest isn't a debt you owe. It's how you come back a better friend.

💬 When did you last rest without guilt? 👇

An imagined reply. The Scripture is quoted as written.
